requirements.unitRule: Single unit, or any combination of matching-style base cabinets at various widths, total exterior run ≤120". Primary criteria: maximize the total count of 4.4"W × 14"D × 4.4"H storage units that fit across the combination — a bay N inches wide contributes floor(N/4.4) width-multiples, not just a pass/fail.
requirements.storagePreference: Cabinet + adjustable shelves preferred; zero drawers preferred, minimal acceptable. Base cabinets only — no wall-mounted or hanging units.
requirements.dividerRule: A door pair opening onto a single continuous bay passes; a center divider splitting it into narrower bays fails, even if overall width looks sufficient.
requirements.availabilityRule: Must be generally available to purchase now. Temporarily out of stock is fine. Amazon's 'Currently unavailable. We don't know when or if this item will be back in stock.' — the outOfStock block, distinct from a normal restock notice — reads as discontinued and disqualifies a candidate regardless of how well it otherwise passed.
requirements.colorRule: Black or dark grey finish only. Checked each surviving candidate's own product-line color variants directly (IKEA product pages link their sibling-color SKUs) rather than assuming a color exists — TONSTAD Cabinet with Doors turned out to ship in off-white only, no black/dark-grey option in that line, and is disqualified on that basis alone despite otherwise being the top dimensional match. HAVSTA (Sideboard and Cabinet with Base) and SEKTION/LERHYTTAN both do offer a black option, at the same price as their white counterparts, so those swapped to black rather than being dropped.

discountCheck.result: No product-specific markdown found on TONSTAD, HAVSTA Sideboard, or HAVSTA Cabinet with Base — each page's own price data shows only the standard current price with no previousPrice/salePrice field. IKEA's active sitewide promo carousel (checked directly in each page's embedded promo data) currently covers mattresses, mattress toppers, KALLAX shelving, dressers, sleeper sofas, desk chairs, and cookware/dinnerware for IKEA Family members through 8/2 — none of it names sideboards, buffets, or cabinets. Re-check periodically; IKEA rotates these promos and a future one could cover this category.

storageUnit.formula: floor(interiorW / 4.4) × floor(interiorD / 14) × floor(interiorClearH / 4.4), computed per bay and summed across every cabinet in a combination.
storageUnit.heightNote: No retailer in this dataset publishes interior clear height (only overall exterior height is published). Every interiorHEst value below is INFERRED using the same ~2" top/bottom panel allowance already observed on TONSTAD's and HAVSTA's own published width offsets — flagged accordingly, not treated as confirmed.

Wayfair's own product pages returned HTTP 429 (rate-limited) on every direct-fetch attempt, so results leaned on brand sites and cross-retailer corroboration rather than Wayfair's own diagrams — thinner coverage than Amazon or IKEA got. Results were dominated by the same SimpliHome lines that fail on Amazon. combinationRule: Working combinations are only built from candidates with zero deficient criteria (i.e. would qualify standalone) — VIHALS, SEKTION, and the Prepac console are excluded here because combining units doesn't fix an individual unit's own height/depth shortfall. Each family shows only combinations that are practically different from each other: the maximum-slot plan at its lowest cost, a same-slot-count 'swap' variant only if substituting a different model in the same family actually changes the cost/verification trade-off, and a fully-verified alternative only if the max plan itself isn't fully verified. Plain fewer-of-the-identical-model subsets (e.g. 2 when 3 fits) are not shown — they're strictly worse with no offsetting benefit.

combinations.label: IKEA's own combo: Sideboard + Cabinet with Base + stacked Glass-door Cabinet
combinations.note: This is a real IKEA combination SKU (article 895.348.29), not something assembled here — its own page lists these exact 3 sub-products. Floor footprint is the same Sideboard + Cabinet with Base pair as the budget mixed plan (79.5", 112 slots), plus a Glass-door Cabinet stacked on top of the Cabinet with Base only, bringing that side up to 83½" tall for display storage behind glass. The glass cabinet contributes 0 to the slot count because it's not a base cabinet (this page counts base cabinets only, agreed earlier) — not a dimensional near-miss — so this plan trails the flat 154-slot maximum on the primary criteria, but it's the only option on this page with genuine display storage above counter height. Priced at exactly $400+$270+$330=$1000, the sum of its 3 parts standalone — no bundle discount or markup, consistent with this page's earlier discount check. 40.5" of the 120" run is still unused here — see the extended version below for whether that's enough for one more cabinet.
